mapper.select: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(o.pay_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS statDate, COUNT(*) AS paidOrderCount, IFNULL(SUM(o.actual_total), 0) AS gmv FROM tz_order o WHERE o.shop_id = #{shopId} AND o.is_payed = 1 AND o.pay_time IS NOT NULL AND o.pay_time >= #{startTime} AND o.pay_time < #{endTime} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(o.pay_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY statDate

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(r.refund_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS statDate, COUNT(*) AS refundCount, IFNULL(SUM(r.refund_amount), 0) AS refundAmount FROM tz_order_refund r WHERE r.shop_id = #{shopId} AND r.return_money_sts = 1 AND r.refund_time IS NOT NULL AND r.refund_time >= #{startTime} AND r.refund_time < #{endTime} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(r.refund_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY statDate
